threshold_pre_registered.rationale: The candidate must demonstrate that the eShunt-specific venous boundary creates failure modes that ventricular-catheter anti-fouling (fibrous-web) CANNOT solve, AND that the combination of surface + backflow produces a non-additive effect. If fibrous-web matches the candidate on venous failure modes, the eShunt-specific mechanism has no value.

competitor_analysis.fibrous_web: 2026 multilayered electrospun fibrous web — ventricular catheter, in vitro only, NOT venous boundary
competitor_analysis.pvp_coating: Conventional polyvinylpyrrolidone — established but ineffective per fibrous-web paper
competitor_analysis.hpc_surface: Hydrophilic polymer coating from neurovascular flow diverters — anti-thrombogenic

ventricular_catheter_cannot_solve: F1 blood/CSF interface fouling — ventricular catheter has no blood contact
F2 venous reflux — ventricular catheter has no venous pressure transients
F3 thrombus formation — ventricular catheter has no blood clot risk
F4 combined fouling+reflux — worst case is venous-specific
eshent_specific_advantage.candidate_advantage: Active backflow prevention addresses F2/F4 which fibrous-web CANNOT solve
